sewers-materials.png.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL production material texture atlas for a top-down dark-fantasy dungeon game. Create a 2048x1024 image containing exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows of equal square panels, no gutters, borders, labels, text or perspective scene. Each panel is a full-bleed square material viewed perfectly orthographically, not an isometric diamond. Rich hand-painted realism, softly blended pigment, convincing worn stone, broad readable forms; absolutely NOT pixel art, no black cartoon outlines, no glossy plastic or repeating ornamental focal motif. Small-scale game readability is paramount. Gentle neutral top-left illumination is baked into relief only, no torch glows or vignette, edges have consistent value. Panel order left to right: TOP ROW: 1) a damp crypt floor made of six broad irregular warm grey limestone flagstones, subtle chipped bevels and very fine pale scratches, average medium-light value, thin dark joints; 2) a second different arrangement of the same worn limestone floor; 3) a third arrangement of the same floor with one small unobtrusive crack, no debris; 4) a special walkway of cool slate-blue square paving with a restrained pale stone cross-inlay, still functional flooring. BOTTOM ROW: 1) vertical masonry face of three courses of large grey-brown dressed stone blocks, shadowed recesses, worn corners, readable highlights, dark-medium value, no moss; 2) broad pale warm limestone wall coping seen from directly above, large smooth blocks, quiet light planes, very few joints; 3) dense low forest-green and yellow-green damp moss and fern ground cover over dark soil, softly painted narrow leaves at varied angles, NO stones, no pavement, distinctly organic; 4) calm very dark desaturated teal-green water, broad smooth translucent flow, a few broken low-contrast silver reflected strokes, no circular ripples, no identical flecks, no rocks or shores. Original art only. No elements, symbols, characters or locations from an existing game. Perfectly straight panel boundaries at the exact halfway height and each quarter width. This is a source atlas to be mechanically cropped into game textures.

props.png.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original hand-painted dark fantasy dungeon PROP SPRITE ATLAS with true transparent alpha background. EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows, each object fully isolated inside its own square cell with at least 8 percent transparent margin. No grid, floor, labels, text, shadows extending outside a cell or checkerboard. Rich painterly realism for a top-down roguelike, smoothly painted surfaces and fine edge highlights, NOT pixel art, not cartoons or vector icons. Consistent slightly elevated frontal orthographic camera: see tops and front faces; verticals remain vertical, no isometric diamonds. Soft warm overhead illumination, diffuse grounded materials, readable silhouette and grouped values at small size. Row 1 left to right: a broad battered wooden barrel with black forged-iron bands; a cluster of long olive-green marsh reeds with fine curved leaves and muddy roots; a cluster of dead pale straw-coloured reeds with wiry stems, clearly distinct from living green reeds; a squat dark hammered-bronze alchemy cauldron, three feet, luminous pale green liquid and a tiny curled wisp. Row 2 left to right: a weathered pale limestone statue of a hooded sentinel on a low square plinth, blank hidden face, hands folded, no weapon; a rough barricade of crossed splintered timber boards and rope, visually blocking passage; a dark oak bookcase packed with old oxblood, moss green and parchment-spined books; a small scattered pile of grey broken stones with one old off-white bone, very low profile. Every object has complete silhouette, no clipping, consistent scale, transparent alpha surrounding each object. No human characters or reference to existing intellectual property. This will be mechanically cropped and packed into game atlases.
